title: Recover an inward-dropped bicycle chain
instruction: Get the bicycle ready to pedal.
justification: A manufacturer-documented ordinary bicycle breakdown. The defining manipulation is recovering an intact articulated chain from the frame-side gap and restoring chain-driven motion, not joining a service link or placing a rigid loop.
fault: Intact chain dropped inward off the smallest chainring into the original frame/chainring clearance; rear routing and chain continuity retained.
objects: Proposed full-scale rear drivetrain on ordinary supports, drive-side up. Surly Cross-Check50cm reference frame geometry:425mm chainstay,66mm BB drop,68mm BB shell. Shimano-recommended RD-M310, FH-RM30-8, CS-HG40-8I11-30 and FC-M31142/32/22; retain front derailleur and all rings. KMC Z8.3 compatible8-speed chain,12.7mm pitch,2.38mm inner width,7.3mm pin length. Exact ring spacing, cage profile/pivot and local tube dimensions remain source gates.
skill: Create and use chain slack, extract an intact chain from a narrow gap, engage actual roller/tooth contacts and restore transmission. Allow safe one-arm, exposed-span and pedal/crank regrasp routes; do not require a particular sequence.
scoring: Proposed only:0.5 for released intact chain freed from the frame gap;1.0 for three actual crank revolutions transmitting through chain/tooth contacts and rear freehub, followed by released retention. Numeric geometry/load/release conditions and final protocol still to be implemented and checked. All current diagnostics score0.

nearest.difference: Commercial chain joining with guided clip applicator; no chain-on-sprocket recovery. No applicator or chain-holding guide will be added.
Rigid rectangular loop substituted for flexible V-belt and working drive; directly relevant warning. This task must have intact articulated links and actual load transmission.
Horseshoe/chain puzzles; no explicit chain-on-sprocket recovery located.

reach_summary: Exposed chain and rear cage landmarks reachable. Stock pedal with30degree wrist tilt reaches24/25 sampled positions; native crank-arm landmarks with30/60/90degree tilt reach25/25. Not collision or continuous-grasp proof. Preserve frame geometry and refine approach only.
risks: Closed-loop pin-chain contact stability and physical lateral flex, not a rope or rigid loop proxy.
Actual frame/cage/ring interference and native gripper mesh clearance.
Passive rear freewheel and chain-driven output, not a pose-triggered engagement flag.
Source-supported plate/roller/tooth and cage dimensions and approximate spring/tension response.
No category or validity credit from artificially requiring bimanual operation.
status: claimed for faithful mechanism prototype and clearance preflight
